description: Re-edit the last recording of this scenario without filming: use it after changing text, narration (say), callouts, style, zoom or output. Changing actions needs screenplay_record. Does not touch the app; writes the video files, and sends new narration text to Cartesia or ElevenLabs when the scenario enables voice-over.

noVoice.description: Skip the voice-over even if the scenario enables it.

path.description: Path of the scenario JSON file. Prefer an absolute path; a relative one is resolved from the server's working directory.

scenario.description: Optional scenario object: validated, then written to `path` (overwriting that file), then used.

name: screenplay_render
title: Edit the last recording again
